name: Starting point
description: The ring of stones where every new character first arrives, close to the middle of the world. It is a calm place to get your bearings, and later the place to bring the trophies of bosses you have beaten.

name: Boss altar
description: A special site where you call a boss by offering the right items. Each boss has its own kind of altar in its home biome; open the boss's panel to see what to offer and how to prepare.

name: Trader
description: The camp of a friendly merchant. Traders do not fight you; you can buy useful gear and supplies from them. They are rare, so note where you find one.

name: Mini-boss lair
description: A place guarded by a single enemy that is much tougher than the creatures around it. Beating it usually earns a special reward, so it is worth coming back once you are well equipped.

name: Dungeon
description: An enclosed place, such as a crypt, a cave or a mine, that you enter through a doorway. Inside it is dark and full of enemies, but it also holds treasure and materials you cannot easily find elsewhere.

name: Village
description: An abandoned settlement now held by hostile creatures. Its buildings hold loot, but groups of enemies guard it, so visit when you are well equipped.

name: Vegvisir site
description: A ruin or stone ring that may hold a Vegvisir: a glowing stone that, when you read it, marks a boss altar on your map. Not every site of this kind has one, so you may need to check several.

name: Runestone
description: A standing stone you can read for a short piece of lore about the world. It is harmless in itself; any danger comes from the biome around it.

name: Landmark
description: A notable place that is easy to recognise, such as a ring of standing stones or a geyser. Some are only scenery; others have creatures or resources nearby.
